title: Etale morphisms are open
statement: Let $f:U\to X$ be an etale morphism of schemes [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Then the map of underlying topological spaces of $f$ is open: the image $f(W)$ of every open subset $W\subseteq U$ is open in $X$. In particular the image of $f$ is open.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 03WT (lemma-etale-open): an etale morphism is open; it follows from Lemma 01UA (lemma-fppf-open), flat and locally of finite presentation morphisms are open
